body.statement: For every fixed candidate count vector \(N\) and every \(q\in[0,1]\), \[\Pr_{A\sim\pi_{\exp},N}\{p_N(H^{\mathrm{obs}})\le q\}\le q.\] This inequality remains valid when the randomization distribution of \(S_N\) is discrete or degenerate.
body.justification: Right-tail super-uniformity is the finite-sample step that handles lattice ties and zero-variance faces without regularity conditions.
body.gap: Current saturation randomization tests obtain exactness only after sharpening individual-level nulls; this lemma instead conditions on a complete candidate schedule count and later takes a composite supremum.
body.consumer: The result supplies exact calibration when the number of clusters is too small for the covariance-based procedures in existing saturation calculators.
